actual_manual_comparison: Actually compared the original and complete unchanged raw output, paired sheet and white/cyan composites. Short dark parted receding hair, brows, rounded dark clear spectacles and clean serious closed-mouth face retained in near-front leftward pose. Navy civilian Chinese high collar, subtle blue shading/pattern, pale inner edge and center fastener preserved without a Western tie, cap or beard. Compact round mascot head and short broad neck fit the widened original collar without clipping, long pillar neck or white belly at neckline. The dark frame, shaded internal backing and aged lower-right paper are retained; exterior transparency is intentional. Whole-image alpha extrema are [0, 255]. Finite interior sampling is numerical support only, not a claim of globally255 interiors. Composites show no material internal holes. Source remains Chinese CCP related archive-only, prohibited from final mod payload; its art gap is not a release blocker. Art approval only; native derivatives and live-game acceptance are separate.
